leftEvidence.title: Those who mourn will be comforted

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus calls those who mourn blessed.
points.right: Jesus stands on a level place among disciples and a crowd, heals, and addresses the poor, hungry, weeping, and rejected.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Their present mourning is set beside future comfort.
points.right: Four blessings are followed by four woes directed to the rich, full, laughing, and well-spoken-of.

payload.posture: Both sayings hold present grief beside a promised reversal.

rightEvidence.title: Luke places blessings and woes on a level place

payload.tension: Matthew says mourners will be comforted; Luke says present weepers will laugh and follows with a woe to those laughing now.
payload.title: Mourning, weeping, comfort, and laughter
